modalLead: The action bar's buttons can come into view in five styles, the dashboard opens faster, and missing icons come back.

items.text: Pick how the buttons come into view: swell, swell from the middle, swell together, unfold or accordion. Under Config → Appearance → Action bar each style has a card that plays it while you point at it, and the bar plays your pick at once. It is still off by default.
The dashboard opens faster, most of all on a second visit: your theme is kept by the browser instead of arriving again with every page.
Config, Bookmarks and Health appear sooner the first time you open them, which you notice most over a VPN or a slow connection.
A long dashboard stays smooth while it draws, instead of stalling for a moment as the bookmarks come in.
Some icons from the icon sets showed a letter instead of the app's icon. They show the icon now.
Inbox links whose icon had gone missing fetch it again, or show their plain symbol when nothing can be found.
